COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action .
   C. Say Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Advocacy in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Advocacy in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community.
   D. Treat Advocacy in the Community as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Building Resilience is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience.
   B. Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Building Resilience as rumours only.
   D. Say Building Resilience never happens in Kenya.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen.
   C. Say Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship.
   B. Say Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

9. Which statement about Making Important Choices is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices.
   B. Treat Making Important Choices as rumours only.
   C. Explain Making Important Choices with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Making Important Choices never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

11. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.
   B. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   B. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Building Resilience 2.2 Support Systems 2.3 Making Important Choices 3.0 Action  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Resilience and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Support Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
